verdict.rationale: The workflow and job APIs document creating, updating, running and deleting workflows, and triggering and monitoring job runs. These are one-off, on-demand executions; no evidence shows a recurring schedule such as cron, intervals or a schedule setting for workflows. missing for 10: any documented recurring schedule for workflows or jobs, schedule configuration via the UI, API or SDK, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
